_doc: N-F3 retrieval evaluation corpus. Lab-shaped: tenant acme is the SD-WAN lab (cEdge/vEdge, mpls + biz-internet transports, vManage/vSmart); tenant globex holds SAME-NAMED runbooks with different text so a wrong-source hit is visible. Cases list the doc ids a correct retrieval must return (relevant), the ones that must come back flagged stale, and questions the corpus cannot answer (relevant empty = must retrieve nothing).

docs.title: sdwan-control-loss
docs.text: when to use: an edge lost its control connections to the vSmart controllers, OMP sessions down, DTLS or TLS control tunnel failing, vBond unreachable

docs.title: mpls-transport-brownout
docs.text: when to use: BFD sessions on the mpls transport colour drop or flap on several edges at once; check the carrier handoff and open a ticket with the MPLS carrier

docs.title: biz-internet-flap
docs.text: when to use: the biz-internet transport flaps on one branch edge; check the ISP modem, the WAN interface errors and the DHCP lease

docs.title: edge-cpu-high
docs.text: when to use: viptela system cpu usage alarms or a pinned control plane CPU on a vEdge or cEdge

docs.title: ntp-drift
docs.text: when to use: clock not synchronised, NTP peer unreachable, certificate errors after a clock jump on an edge

docs.title: bgp-ce-peer-down
docs.text: when to use: a BGP peer to the service-side CE router goes idle or flaps on a cEdge; check the LAN interface and the neighbour config
